purpose: Teach: 藁/便所/破片/咲かせ/襟/受かっ/刈り/恩返し

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「藁ぶき屋根の伝統建築」を見せて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was kind enough to show us that traditional building with the thatched straw roof.
lines.style: Soft, unhurried opening on his name. Gentle storytelling warmth, savoring the memory as she speaks.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと公園の便所、つまり公衆トイレに行ったよ
lines.en: Auntie Mei, me and Dad went to the park benjo — the public bathroom, I mean!
lines.style: Small careful voice, a serious self-correction in the middle, then brightening proudly at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「ガラスの破片に注意しよう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad did say we should watch out for shards of glass, remember?
lines.style: Gently cautionary, slowing over the quoted warning, kind and clear like a soft reminder.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと花を咲かせる種を植えたよ
lines.en: Auntie Mei, me and Dad planted seeds that are gonna make flowers bloom!
lines.style: Quiet excitement bubbling up, a little rush on the seeds, ending with a shy breathy smile.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「お祭りで襟を正して」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad told you to straighten your collar for the festival, didn't he.
lines.style: Playful imitation of Dad's firmness on the quote, then melting back into soft amusement.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「英検に受かった」って報告したよ
lines.en: Auntie Mei, I told Dad, 'I passed the Eiken test!'
lines.style: Careful, proud delivery, sitting up straighter in the voice, a small pause before the big news.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと田んぼの稲を刈り体験したよ
lines.en: Sho, you got to try cutting rice in the paddy with your dad, didn't you.
lines.style: Warm remembering tone, gentle rhythm like retelling a favorite story, a soft lift at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「恩返しの気持ちで頑張る」って約束したよ
lines.en: Auntie Mei, me and Dad made a promise — I'm gonna do my best to give back for everything.
lines.style: Solemn little-boy sincerity, slow and deliberate on the promise, quietly glowing by the close.
